title: Pure Mannadium
summary: The pure Mannadium Synchro build with Visas Starfrost, Peaceful Planet Calarium, and generic Level 6 to 10 Synchro bosses. Every Main Deck Mannadium card revolves around Visas Starfrost or monsters with 1500 ATK and 2100 DEF, destroying your own Level 2 Mannadium Tuners to recruit replacements from the Deck.

summary.title: Starters
points: Mannadium Riumheart (1500 ATK / 2100 DEF) searches any Mannadium card on Normal or Special Summon, and can Special Summon itself from the hand during the Main Phase by destroying a Mannadium monster or a 1500/2100 monster you control.
Peaceful Planet Calarium searches a Mannadium monster or Visas Starfrost on activation and revives a Tuner once per turn when a face-up Tuner you control is destroyed by battle or card effect.
Mannadium Abscission destroys a monster you control to search Peaceful Planet Calarium or any Mannadium Spell or Trap.

summary.title: Opening: Riumheart + Meek into Trisukta & Synchro Climb
steps: Normal Summon Mannadium Riumheart to search Mannadium Meek (orMannadium Abscission if you already hold a Tuner), then Special Summon Meek next to Riumheart.
Activate Mannadium Abscission (or Visas Starfrost in hand) to destroy Mannadium Meek and search Peaceful Planet Calarium.
Meek triggers in the GY to summon a second Mannadium Meek from the Deck and increase its Level by 2 (to Level 4), while Calarium revives the destroyed Level 2 Meek.

Synchro Summon Level 6 Mannadium Trisukta using Level 2 Meek and Level 4 Riumheart; Trisukta revives a Level 2 Tuner from the GY and resets its Level, climbing into Mannadium Prime-Heart and Bystial Dis Pater.

summary.title: Self-Destruction Tuner Orbs
summary.text: Mannadium Meek, Mannadium Fearless, and Mannadium Torrid all Special Summon themselves from the hand while you control Visas Starfrost or a 1500 ATK / 2100 DEF monster. Whenever any of the three is destroyed by battle or card effect, it Special Summons another Mannadium Tuner from the Deck—with Meek optionally raising the new Tuner's Level to 4 and Fearless boosting Synchro ATK.

summary.title: Bosses & Payoff
points: Mannadium Prime-Heart is a 3000 ATK Level 10 Synchro that cannot be targeted by opposing card effects while Synchro Summoned using a Mannadium Tuner, and attacks a number of times each Battle Phase up to the number of Tuners used as material.
Mannadium Trisukta is a Level 6 Synchro Tuner that revives a Level 2 Tuner on summon to immediately climb into Level 8 or Level 10 Synchros like Crystal Wing Synchro Dragon and Bystial Dis Pater.
Desert Locusts and Shooting Riser Dragon provide Quick Effect Synchro Summons on the opponent's turn into Kuibelt the Blade Dragon or Lightstorm Dragon.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Mannadium Imaginings reveals a Mannadium or Visas Starfrost in hand to draw 2 cards and place 1 on the bottom of the Deck, and banishes itself from the GY to treat a 1500/2100 monster as a Tuner.
Mannadium Reframing is a searchable Counter Trap that negates any Spell, Trap, or monster effect activation while you control a Synchro Monster.
Mannadium Breakheart revives a Tuner or Synchro Monster and destroys an opposing monster with equal or lower ATK if you revived a LIGHT monster.

allow.Peaceful Planet Calarium: Mannadium Abscission searches it, and it searches a Mannadium or Visas Starfrost.
